def createparser():
    """Return an ArgumentParser for the pysemver CLI."""
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='pysemver')
    parser.add_argument('version', help='Version string to process')
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')
    # Subcommands for bumping
    for name in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
        subparsers.add_parser(name, help=f'bump {name}')
    # Replace command
    replace_parser = subparsers.add_parser('replace', help='Replace components')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--major', type=int, help='New major')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--minor', type=int, help='New minor')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--patch', type=int, help='New patch')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--prerelease', help='New prerelease')
    replace_parser.add_argument('--build', help='New build')
    return parser


def process(args=None):
    """Process command-line arguments and return the resulting version string."""
    import argparse, sys
    parser = createparser()
    parsed = parser.parse_args(args)
    vi = VersionInfo.parse(parsed.version)
    if parsed.command in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
        vi = getattr(vi, f'bump_{parsed.command}')()
    elif parsed.command == 'replace':
        vi = vi.replace(
            major=getattr(parsed, 'major', None),
            minor=getattr(parsed, 'minor', None),
            patch=getattr(parsed, 'patch', None),
            prerelease=getattr(parsed, 'prerelease', None),
            build=getattr(parsed, 'build', None)
        )
    return str(vi)


def main():
    """Entry point for the pysemver command-line tool."""
    import sys
    print(process(sys.argv[1:]))


def replace(version, **kwargs):
    """Return a new version string with components replaced according to kwargs."""
    vi = VersionInfo.parse(version)
    vi = vi.replace(**kwargs)
    return str(vi)
